drafts.subject: Revised launch timeline
drafts.body:
Hi Maya,

We’ve moved the internal review to Thursday so the team has time to incorporate your feedback. The public launch stays on Monday. Could you confirm the revised milestones before I share the timeline?

Thanks,
Alex

drafts.subject: Notes from our studio visit
drafts.body:
Hi Noah,

Thank you for showing us around the studio. The material samples were especially helpful. I’ve pulled together our notes and would love to arrange a short follow-up next week to talk through the two directions we discussed.

Best,
Alex

drafts.subject: Friday’s review agenda
drafts.body:
Hi Lena,

For Friday’s review, let’s start with the updated prototypes, then leave fifteen minutes for open questions. Please add any decisions you need from the group so we can keep the discussion focused.

Thanks,
Alex

drafts.subject: Proposal for the autumn series
drafts.body:
Hi Theo,

I’d like to propose three small workshops for the autumn series, each built around a different making process. If the outline feels right, I can put together a more detailed brief with materials and a suggested schedule.

Best,
Alex
